summary: Iteration 93 tested brands-only Market (admin brands, brand email invites with set-password links, brand portal), the Admin Portal shared key, and Accounts & roles. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass after one fix by T1. Bug fixed: password_set was always false in every brand-account response because the queries removed password_hash before _account_public read it. The admin UI therefore kept showing 'Invite pending' / 'Resend invite' for activated logins, and the 'Invites pending' stat was wrong. Frontend at 390x844: every requested flow passed (cockpit tiles, /admin/brands, set-password, /brand portal, /admin/accounts, /admin/portal) plus the regression smoke. Remaining issues are minor: nested <button> console error on /brand, stale invite fallback card after the login is removed, one-tap Remove with no confirmation, truncated stat labels. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.endpoint: GET /api/admin/brands, PATCH /api/admin/brands/{id}, POST …/accounts, POST …/accounts/{aid}/invite, GET /api/brand/me, POST /api/brand/auth/set-password
minor.issue: FIXED BY T1: password_set was always false. The account queries used the projection {'_id':0,'password_hash':0}, but _account_public computes password_set = bool(a.get('password_hash')). The projections now only remove _id. _account_public is an explicit whitelist, so the hash is never returned (checked: no hash in any response).
Doesn't check that lead_id exists. Any id is upserted into portal_leads_meta and written to the audit log.
There is no delete or archive endpoint for brands, so a QA or mistaken brand can only be hidden, not removed (T1 cleaned up through the DB).

The email_error text comes from the generic send_email helper: "…can't receive email right now. Check the address on your profile." 'On your profile' makes no sense for an admin inviting a brand manager; use wording specific to brand invites.

ui_bugs.issue: Console error 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' (hydration warning) because Card onPress wraps the Hide/Show Button. Reference: /app/frontend/app/brand/index.tsx:117 and :137

ui_bugs.component: Admin brand sheet invite fallback card
ui_bugs.issue: After the account is removed (or disabled), the 'Share this single-use link' fallback card still shows the now-dead link, because lastInvite isn't cleared on delete/toggle. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/brands.tsx:201,344
Remove deletes a brand login in one tap with no confirmation.

issues: StatTile values and labels are cut off at 390px: '3,…' Members, 'Suspe…'
The 'Add product' button squeezes the header title ('QA UI Brand …', 'Smoke Lighti…'); the 'Live produ…' stat label is cut off
The brand card shows a 'Verified brand' badge even when an admin has hidden the brand from Market → Brands; nothing tells the brand it is hidden
The submit button is silently disabled for passwords under 8 characters or that don't match; there is no inline hint explaining why
After 'Make AMASS admin', the sheet body shows no 'AMASS admin' badge (the button label does change). Minor.

action_items: Review T1's fix in /app/backend/brands.py: the account projections no longer remove password_hash, so password_set is correct and the admin UI shows Active / 'Send reset link'.
Fix the nested <button> on /brand product rows (/app/frontend/app/brand/index.tsx:117/137): stop the Hide/Show Button sitting inside a pressable Card, or render the Card as a non-button wrapper.
Clear lastInvite in AdminBrandSheet when the matching account is deleted or disabled; add a confirm step to Remove.

Optional: make send_email errors specific to brand invites; validate lead_id in PATCH /api/portal/leads/{id}/status; add an archive/delete endpoint for brands; fix truncated stat labels on /admin/accounts and /brand; add an inline password hint on set-password.
critical_code_review_comments: brands.py: removing password_hash in the projection and then deriving password_set from it was a logic bug (fixed). Pattern to avoid: derive flags before stripping secrets.
portal_keys.authenticate_key does a find plus a separate update_one ($inc uses) on every portal request. Fine at this scale; consider throttling the last_used writes.
Brand forgot-password is enumeration-safe and throttled per account. Set-password unsets the invite, so links are single-use (410 on reuse). Good.
Brand-scoped JWTs are correctly rejected on /api/auth/me and /api/admin/* (401). Portal keys are rejected on app/admin APIs (401).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; minor UI issues listed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the ':visible' locator suffix. RN-web stacks keep hidden copies of screens, so plain [data-testid] matches hidden nodes. Toggles have no aria-checked; check persistence through the API or DB. Shop routes: /shop/stores and /shop/store/<slug> (no /shop index). Invite links only come from the fallback (amass-qa.africa can't receive email). Run python /app/backend/tests/helper_iter93_cleanup.py to clean up.
rca_of_issue: password_set always false. Repro: GET /api/admin/brands as admin, and Smoke Lighting Co's account (password set) showed password_set=false. RCA: db.brand_accounts.find(..., {'_id':0,'password_hash':0}) then _account_public -> bool(a.get('password_hash')) is always False. Fix: keep password_hash in the internal fetch; _account_public whitelists the output fields, so nothing leaks. Verified: both Lumen and Smoke now return true and no hash appears in the responses.
